summary: Feature implemented but not executed (per instructions: no test runs, no installs, no commits). Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and refactored SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (engine-accepting completion wrapper around finalize), and TensorBoardImageHandler (index param) into thin adapters. nifti_writer default dtype is now np.float32. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Verified by reading only: no lines over 120 characters in touched files. Not verified: flake8 run, unit tests, ignite 0.3.0 attach behavior.
